scope: Independent r22 high-particle fixed-root normalizer runs; finite SMC only.
vertex_rule: root=y*11+x; adjacent coordinates are asserted to have Manhattan distance 1
seed_rule: 0xA0228000 + root*2^36; program derives replicate seed deterministically
normalizer: h_root: count of high-to-low labelled one-peak orders whose first/highest-labelled peak is root; not divided by N!
